answer: Require each new agent to lock 300 POA for 35 epochs and clear four verification rounds, each needing approval from at least five of seven randomly chosen established agents. A second identity from the same funding source must lock 900 POA, a third 1800 POA, and a fourth 3000 POA, so every extra fake costs more than the last. Auditors check the lock, funding graph and past attestations on chain, slashing half the bond for fraud and freezing linked accounts. Like timber hauled across a frozen tundra, cheap copies cannot reach the zenith of trust without paying the full journey.
